# Dependencies

Direct dependencies of every workspace package, with the exact version resolved in `yarn.lock` and the license declared by the installed package.

- **runtime** — needed by the published ContextVerity plugins.
- **demo (lab)** — only the local Backstage lab in `packages/` uses it.
- **build/test** — development, tests and tooling only.

Runtime dependencies of the plugins: `@backstage/backend-plugin-api`, `@backstage/catalog-model`, `@backstage/plugin-catalog-common`, `@backstage/plugin-permission-common`, `knex`, `@opentelemetry/api`, `@backstage/config`, `@backstage/errors`, `@backstage/plugin-catalog-node`, `express`, `express-promise-router`, `yaml`, `@backstage/frontend-plugin-api`, `@backstage/ui`. None requires a proprietary service; no language-model SDK is a dependency.
